description: Dialog (a core TmModal) for importing tasks from Excel, MS Project XML, or JIRA: ARIA tabs for the source, a file input group (Choose file, the chosen name, Remove file) with a supported-formats hint, an error TmAlert and, on the Excel tab of a result-capable GanttXlsx package, a column-mapping step that produces the full import result (tasks, dependencies, warnings).

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the dialog should close.

parameters.name: OnImportCompleted
parameters.description: Fires when import completes successfully (tasks only; the full result travels through OnImportResultCompleted).

parameters.name: OnImportResultCompleted
parameters.description: Fires when a result-capable Excel import finishes: tasks, dependencies and warnings in one payload. When handled, this event replaces the task-only OnImportCompleted for the Excel flow — MS Project and JIRA keep firing the task-only event. Warnings keep the dialog open so their alert can be read; the import itself is never blocked.

parameters.name: ImportMappings
parameters.description: Mappings the column-mapping dialog starts from (a remembered choice, a host's own defaults); forwarded to TmGanttImportMappingDialog.InitialMappings.

parameters.name: OnImportError
parameters.description: Fires when import fails with an error message.
